lines.t: I grew up in the crossfire, learned to bleed and call it pride
Wore my trauma like a normal, swore I'd never lay you aside
Blame the world for all my damage
Curse the sky for every scar
Use the pain just like a weapon
Can't be loaded in my heart
But every time I raise my fist
I can feel you closing in
Like a storm behind my ribcage
Tearing down the walls I'm in
You're a wildfire in my bones
Breaking down my alibis
Jealous love that won't let go
Hunting down my perfect lies
Take the wounds, take the sin
Every war I start within
If I fight, you burn straight through
I cannot run a God like you
I've been hiding in religion
Playing victim, talking tough
Pointing fingers at the villains
Never saying I've had enough
I've been drunk on my excuses
Calling bitterness my shield
But your anger at my darkness
Is the fire that makes me kneel
Every secret that I bury starts to shake when you draw near
You don't whisper, you come roaring, calling out what I won't hear
You're a wildfire in my bones, breaking down my alibis
Jealous love that won't let go, hunting down my perfect lies
Take the wounds, take the sin
Every war I'll start within
If I fight, you'll burn straight through
I can't outrun a God like you
Set my idols all on fire
Let the smoke choke out my pride
If I burn it, let it be
Every lie I've lived inside
Hear the boy they try to break
You're a wildfire in my bones, crashing through my last defense
Jealous love that shakes the throne of every false innocence
Take the wounds, take the sin
Drag the darkness out of them
If I run, you tear right through
I was made to be claimed by you
You
